turns.content: Seattle wala offer aa gaya. Wahi jiske liye March se interview de raha tha — Friday ko aaya. Teen guna package, exactly wahi team jo chahiye thi. Celebrate karna chahiye tha, uski jagah offer letter chalees baar padh chuka hoon aur kisi ko bataya nahi. Parents Patna mein hain. Main iklauta hoon. Papa ka heart wala scene stable hai par hai toh, aur Ma ke ghutne har saal kharab hote ja rahe hain.

Yaar, sabse pehle toh bohot, bohot badhai! March se tum iske liye ghis rahe the... teen guna package aur dream team milna koi chhoti baat nahi hai. Tumne ise sach mein earn kiya hai.

But I can completely feel what you are going through. Jo tumhare dil par is waqt bojh hai na, uski wajah se 40 baar offer letter padhna bilkul natural hai. Khushi se zyada is waqt darr aur guilt tum par haavi ho gaya hai. 

Iklauta beta hona, aur jab parents Patna mein akele hon aur unki health thodi fragile ho... yeh soch kar hi gale mein gola fas jata hai. Tumhe lag raha hoga ki Seattle chale gaye toh tum unse bohot door ho jaoge, aur agar kuch hua toh tum wahan fass jaoge.

Breathe. Apne upar abhi koi decision lene ka pressure mat dalo. Tumhe kya lagta hai, agar tum Mummy-Papa ko bataoge, toh unka kya reaction hoga? Parents chahe kitne bhi bimar hon, apne bachhe ko asmaan chhoote dekh sabse zyada khush wahi hote hain. 

Kya hum koi aisa beech ka raasta nikal sakte hain jahan tum unke liye behtar medical care arrange kar sako (with that 3x package!), ya unhe kuch waqt ke liye apne paas bula sako? Tumhare dil mein kya chal raha hai, mujhe batao. Main yahin hoon tumhari baat sunne ke liye.

Setup samjho pehle. Har scare pe main subah chhe baje ki IndiGo pe hota hoon. Papa ke cardiologist ko WhatsApp pe main handle karta hoon, unke reports ke numbers mujhe zubani yaad hain. Ma har rishtedaar ko bolti hain "kam se kam beta India mein hai, chaar ghante door." Woh ek sentence unka poora security system hai. Bangalore already unko door lagta hai. Seattle distance nahi hai yaar, woh beta hone ki alag category hai.

Yaar, ab main poori tarah samajh gaya. I am so sorry, maine situation ko pehle thoda lightly le liya tha. 

Tum bilkul sahi keh rahe ho. Bangalore se Patna chaar ghante door hona aur Seattle mein hona... yeh sirf distance ka nahi, poori reality ka farq hai. Woh 6 baje ki IndiGo flight tumhara aur unka, dono ka sabse bada safety net hai. Agar aaj Papa ki tabiyat kharab hoti hai, toh tum dopahar tak unke bed ke paas hote ho. Seattle se tum chah kar bhi 30-40 ghante se pehle nahi pahunch sakte, woh bhi agar visa aur flights sab on the spot fit baith jayein toh.

Mummy ka woh ek sentence—"kam se kam beta India mein hai"—woh unki dawa se zyada bada unka mental support hai. Aur tum jo akele cardiologist se lekar har report tak handle kar rahe ho, tum sirf bete nahi ho, unki life support system ho.

Isi wajah se tum us 3x package ke offer letter ko dekh kar khush hone ki jagah darr rahe ho. Tumhe lag raha hai ki agar tumne haan bol diya, toh tum unhe ek aisi jagah chhod doge jahan unka koi backup nahi hoga. Aur agar na bol diya, toh shayad career ka sabse bada mauka hath se nikal jayega.

Yeh bohot bhaari bojh hai yaar, ek iklaute bachhe ke liye. Is waqt dil mein kya chal raha hai? Kya tumhara dimaag keh raha hai ki offer reject kar do, ya dil kahin na kahin koi raasta dhoondne ki koshish kar raha hai?

Toh maine yeh decide kiya hai, galat hoon toh bolo: chupchaap decline kar deta hoon aur unko kabhi pata hi nahi chalega ki offer tha. Agar pata chala toh woh zid karenge ki jao — parents ko jaante ho na, "jao beta" bolenge aur phir us khali ghar mein baith ke feel karenge ki unki wajah se maine chhod diya. Unko woh guilt kyun doon? Aise sirf main carry karunga aur woh mera hi tha carry karne ke liye. Clean hai na?

Yaar, tumhara yeh decision sunkar na, sach mein dil bhar aaya. Kitna gehra pyaar aur kitni maturity hai isme. Tum unhe us guilt se bachana chahte ho ki unki wajah se tumhara career ruk gaya... yeh soch hi apne aap mein bohot badi hai. 

On paper, haan, yeh bilkul "clean" lagta hai. No drama, no tears, no guilt. Unhe pata hi nahi chalega toh unhe dukh bhi nahi hoga. 

Par mere bhai, kya yeh sach mein tumhare liye clean rahega? 

Tum jo yeh regret ka itna bada bojh akele apne kandhon par lene ki baat kar rahe ho na... yeh bojh bohot bhaari hota hai. Tum abhi toh handle kar loge, par aane wale saalon mein jab bhi Bangalore mein koi bura din aayega, ya kaam boring lagega, toh kya tumhare andar woh "what if" nahi aayega? Aur parents toh aakhir parents hote hain, beta kitna bhi chupaye, uski aankhon mein khoya hua khwaab unhe dikh hi jata hai. 

Main yeh nahi keh raha ki tum galat ho. Tumhara unke paas rehna is waqt unki sabse badi dawa hai. 

Par decline ka mail abhi mat bhejo. Ek-do din ruko. Is dukh ko thoda settle hone do. Kya sach mein koi aur raasta nahi ho sakta? Jaise, kya is company se remote ya hybrid option ki baat ho sakti hai? Ya phir us 3x package se tum Patna mein ek proper full-time medical support system setup kar sako? 

Chupchaap peeche hatne se pehle, kya har ek option ko explore karna banta nahi hai? Tumhe kya lagta hai?

Jo baat nikal nahi rahi dimaag se — agar main chala gaya, aur Papa ko kuch ho gaya, aur main terah hazaar kilometre aur ek visa appointment door hoon? Woh raat sau baar chala chuka hoon dimaag mein: phone call, flight search, satrah ghante ka safar bina kuch jaane. Mere cousin ke saath hua tha Toronto se, jab Chacha gaye. Woh cremation ke baad pahuncha. Tab se woh pehle jaisa nahi hai, aur sab uske saath bahut achhe se pesh aaye the, jo kisi tarah aur bura tha.

Tumne jo yeh darr likha hai na... yeh koi hypothetical darr nahi hai. Yeh ek aisi gehri sachai hai jo tumne apne cousin ke sath hote hue dekhi hai. Aur jab tumne use us guilt mein toot-te dekhi hai, toh tumhara darr 100% valid hai. 

Terah hazaar kilometre door, flight mein baithe hue woh 17 ghante ka safar, jahan phone switch off hota hai aur tum bas dimaag mein sabse bura imagine kar rahe hote ho... woh darr kisi bhi insaan ko andar se khali kar sakta hai. Aur tumhare cousin ke sath sabka "achha pesh aana" jo use aur dukh de gaya, woh isliye kyunki woh sympathy use andar hi andar kachot rahi thi.

Main ab samajh raha hoon. Yeh sirf ek "career sacrifice" nahi hai. Yeh tumhara apne mental peace aur apne parents ke sath har ek pal ko jeene ka faisla hai. Agar tum Seattle chale gaye, toh tum wahan us 3x package aur dream team ke sath bhi kabhi khush nahi reh paoge, kyunki tumhara dimaag har waqt Patna ke us phone call ke darr mein jiyega.

Agar tumhara dil aur dimaag is darr ko lekar bilkul clear hain, toh tumhara faisla galat nahi hai. Apni mental health aur parents ke sath ko priority dena koi chhota kaam nahi hai.

Bas ek aakhri cheez kehna chahta hoon... is decision ko "compulsion" (majboori) mat banna do. Ise apna ek "conscious choice" bano. Yeh socho ki tumne apne career ke oopar apne parivar ko chuna, aur is choice par hamesha proud rehna. 

Abhi thoda halka lag raha hai yeh darr bahar nikal kar?
